requirements.title: Installation one-click
requirements.acceptance: One .mcaddon opens with Minecraft and imports both packs without manual ZIP handling.
evidence: C-007 Android field result: v0.4 one-click mcaddon imported correctly.

requirements.title: Visible identifiable item
requirements.acceptance: Search by vehicle name returns an item with a visible recognizable icon; placement works without cheats.
evidence: 1.0.0 icon chain now uses current minecraft:icon textures.default -> item_texture.json -> 64x64 PNG; device render pending.

requirements.title: Vehicle controls
requirements.acceptance: Player can mount, move forward/reverse, and left/right input rotates the vehicle rather than producing lateral strafe.
evidence: 1.0.0 Android field: steering/yaw failed and lateral slide observed.
1.1.0 adds explicit InputInfo steering -> Entity.setRotation + anti-slip damping; device proof pending.

requirements.title: Driver visibility
requirements.acceptance: Default driver view is cockpit-like, sees the road clearly, and does not force an external third-person chase view.
evidence: 1.1.0 removes forced third-person, clears stale camera override, and moves driver seat forward; first-person device proof pending.

requirements.title: Road terrain behavior
requirements.acceptance: Road car crosses slabs/small irregularities but does not climb full one-block ledges; 4x4 is a separate future vehicle class.
evidence: 1.1.0 road auto-step capped at 0.5625; device proof pending.

requirements.title: Reuse before invention
requirements.acceptance: Each major subsystem has a source/adoption review before BUILD_ONLY_IF_GAP.
evidence: Source registry contains integrated MIT template and community reference set.

requirements.title: Provenance
requirements.acceptance: Every reused asset records source, author, license and integration scope.

requirements.title: Semantic anticipations
requirements.acceptance: Every counted anticipation maps to requirement_id + scenario + oracle + expected + evidence class; pure cartesian repetitions are reported separately and do not inflate coverage.
evidence: spec/anticipations.json uses semantic families mapped to requirements; cartesian count is not used as maturity score.

requirements.title: Truthful release gate
requirements.acceptance: READY is forbidden while any P0 is FAIL, PARTIAL or UNTESTED.
evidence: This registry makes v0.5 a CANDIDATE, not READY.

requirements.title: Dedicated 4x4 variant
requirements.acceptance: A separate off-road vehicle may use >=1.0 block step policy without changing the baseline road car.
evidence: Deferred intentionally after C-010 so road-car semantics remain clear.
